settings.lede: Delivery, returns, payment and orders: the quick answers.

settings.a: Yes. Every product we sell is 100% authentic, and Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga and Vilvah.
Orders are dispatched from the UK within 1–2 working days.
Standard UK delivery is £1.99 (3–4 business days) and free on orders over £40; orders over £70 also get £5 off. Two-day (£2.99) and next-day (£3.99) delivery are available at checkout.

settings.q: Do you deliver outside the UK?
settings.a: At the moment we deliver to UK addresses only.

You can return unopened, sealed items within 14 days of delivery (return postage is paid by you). Damaged, faulty or wrong items are replaced or refunded at no cost. Our refund policy has the details.
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Maestro, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Shop Pay. Eligible orders can also be split into interest-free payments where this is offered at checkout.

settings.q: How do I track my order?
settings.a: Sign in to your account with the email you ordered with to see your orders and tracking.
Use our contact page, email us, or send us a message on Instagram.
